description: superblockify is a Python package for partitioning an urban street network into candidate superblock neighbourhoods. The JOSS paper describes reducing through traffic while prioritizing walking and cycling, and the own repository provides visualization and analysis functions. Spatial coverage is the city street graph supplied; temporal coverage is a proposed planning state, not a historical travel survey. The public repository reports AGPL-3.0. Its partitions can serve as network-change scenarios for traffic, accessibility or emergency-response simulations. A caveat is that a generated partition does not establish traffic displacement, legal feasibility or resident support. Those effects require separate demand models and consultation. The package is a planning aid, not a built street intervention. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own README were inspected without downloading a road network or generating a superblock.
name: superblockify urban street partitions
